mainEntity.name: Will it prevent me from getting sick?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no IV that guarantees immunity. The protocol supports immune function and provides nutrients the body needs when defending itself. Combined with good sleep, hydration and stress management, it can reduce vulnerability and accelerate recovery. We do not promise prevention — we support function.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will I feel the effect?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many patients feel less fatigued by the end of the infusion itself, particularly when starting from a depleted state. The immune-support component works over the following days as the body utilises the nutrients delivered. Effect is most evident when the IV is done early in the illness or stress cycle.

Yes, NAD+ IM (intramuscular) is available as an add-on after the IV, particularly useful when energy or cognitive recovery is the priority. Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C will discuss whether the combination is right for you during the visit.

hero.title: IV Immunity & Energy in Miami
hero.lede: An IV protocol designed to support immune function and restore energy through a high-dose vitamin C base, zinc, B-complex and selected minerals to strengthen defences during demanding seasons.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Supports the immune system during cold-and-flu season, periods of stress or travel.
Combines high-dose vitamin C with zinc and B-vitamins for compounded effect.
Restores energy when fatigue is linked to low nutrient status or recovery from illness.
Session is approximately 60 minutes in a comfortable clinical environment.
Medically supervised — reviewed against your health history and medications.
Recommended cadence: 1–2 sessions during demanding seasons or as a recovery boost.
